Chapter 592 - Ambush

Chapter 592 - Ambush

Zhao Feng shook his head as he left the guest rooms, not surprised by the result. It was logical that the two Sacred Land geniuses wouldn’t want to help him, but he still wanted to try his luck.

Zhao Feng then contacted Xiao Ma and Loulan Zhishui as he returned to the hotel.

“Captain, almost all the resources you wanted have been gathered, and the Primal Crystal Stones you gained from selling your resources have been used to buy the materials you need.”

Xiao Ma took out the list and went down one by one.

When it came to buying and selling the items, Xiao Ma used his connections while Loulan Zhishui oversaw the process.

“Okay, we will leave in three days’ time.”

Zhao Feng decided.

The Void Ocean Spiritual Palace was a high-ranked restocking point, so all his requirements had been met. It was time to leave.

“Xiao Ma, here’s your reward.”

Zhao Feng threw an interspatial ring over to Xiao Ma, and his heart jumped when he saw what was inside.

“Thank you, Captain.”

Xiao Ma bowed multiple times with gratitude.

Apart from a pile of Primal Crystal Stones, there was also a barrel of heart blood essence.

The pile of Primal Crystal Stones was comparable to him working for several years, and the barrel of heart blood essence was something from his dreams.

Xiao Ma gave Zhao Feng a deep glance before he left. With this barrel of heart blood essence, his state of existence would rise by leaps and bounds. As long as he took this step, his life would be changed forever.

Within the room:

“Is there no hope at all to use the Spiritual Zone Teleportation Array?”

Zhao Feng started to think.

It was a long journey to travel throughout the territory of the Spiritual Sacred Lands. He estimated that it would take over a dozen years if the journey was smooth. However, if he used the Spiritual Zone Teleportation Array, more than half of that time would be saved.

Unfortunately, those two from the Sacred Land wouldn’t help Zhao Feng.

Shua!

A purple-colored token appeared in Zhao Feng’s hand; the Purple Saint Token.

There was a connection between the Purple Saint Token and the Purple Saint Ruins. He could open a path to the ruins using the token, and the token itself contained unusual power.

“The Purple Saint Token can be used three times. I’ve already used it once.”

Zhao Feng closed his eyes and sensed it.

The aura on the other side of the Purple Saint Token was already extremely weak. It was because the distance was extremely far, and the dimension itself was losing power or else he could open a path back into the ruins.

Although the Thousand Flowing Islands Zone and Tianlu Islands Zone were next to each other, the Purple Saint Partial Spirit’s current strength probably wasn’t enough.

Luckily, Zhao Feng didn’t have any intentions of returning to the Purple Saint Ruins.

“Senior Purple Saint, my destination is too far away and I need to use the Spiritual Zone Teleportation Array in the True Martial Sacred Land….”

Zhao Feng sent this wisp of information across.

The difficulty of opening a connection was huge and would waste the Purple Saint Partial Spirit and the dimension’s strength, but exchanging information didn’t require much energy.

However, there was no reaction at all.

“Did something happen in the Purple Saint Ruins?”

Zhao Feng’s eyebrows furrowed.

After half the time it took tea to be made later, a sigh came from the Purple Saint Token; “Zhao Feng, go to the True Martial Sacred Land and find someone called Duanmu Qing with my Purple Saint Token, but I don’t know if that person is still alive or not. If he is then he’ll definitely help you. He can be trusted.”

“True Martial Sacred Land? Duanmu Qing? Great!”

Zhao Feng was overjoyed. He only asked the Purple Saint Partial Spirit on a whim, he didn’t really have any hope.

Anyone that was related to the Purple Spirit Partial Spirit and still alive today wouldn’t be a simple figure.

“Brother Zhao Feng, the Purple Saint Ruins is doing well, you don’t need to worry….”

Zhao Yufei’s voice sounded through the Purple Saint Token.

The two were able to contact each other through the Purple Saint Token, but they couldn’t talk for too long since the distance was too great and the burden on the Purple Saint Token and the dimension of the Purple Saint Ruins would be big.

At the same time, within the third floor of the Treasured Palace in the Purple Saint Ruins:

Weng~~

A purple-robed young female sat in front of a crystal key.

The girl in purple had snow-white skin that glistened, and she seemed as elegant as a goddess.

“Yufei, it looks like your Spiritual Race bloodline is about to awaken. Even though your mental energy hasn’t reached the Origin Core Realm, your still able to convert such pure half-step True Yuan. You’ll be able to fully refine True Yuan soon.”

The Purple Saint Partial Spirit smiled and said.

It was incredible to refine True Yuan without one’s mental energy reaching the Origin Core Realm. Although there were some instances of this happening, it was either from great fortune, or from giving cultivation to someone else, which couldn’t actually be purified by them and would be in a sealed state instead.

On the other hand, Zhao Yufei was able to purify and refine it herself.

“The Spiritual Race is ranked as one of the best even among the Ten Thousand Ancient Races.”

The Purple Saint Partial Spirit nodded her head.

Three days later, near one of the entrances of the Void Ocean Spiritual Palace:

“That brat’s finally come out and getting ready to leave.”

“Report this to Third Elder.”

A couple normal-looking figures nearby communicated through Spiritual Sense.

Shua! Shua!

These figures flashed away in the blink of an eye.

A couple breaths later:

Sou! Sou! Sou!

Zhao Feng and his group flew out of the Void Ocean Spiritual Palace.

Shua!

Zhao Feng raised his hand, and the new Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship appeared and released a powerful pressure.

“What a strong aura. That ship is one of extremely high quality.”

Many people turned around near the entrance while Zhao Feng led the sailors into the ship.

The inside of the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship was elegant and seemed like a high-class hotel. In addition, the strength and defense of the materials were strong.

Loulan Zhishui and company went in and got to work.

After absorbing the heart blood essence, the states of existence of many sailors were approaching the half-step Origin Core Realm, and they had even more potential.

Loulan Zhishui had easily broken through to the late-stage True Lord Rank.

“Let’s go.”

Zhao Feng sat in the nicely decorated captain’s cabin and ordered.

Weng~~

A ripple of water and lightning appeared on the surface of the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship as it shot past the barrier of the Void Ocean Spiritual Palace and into the limitless ocean.

“Follow them!”

An elder wearing a plain shirt and two Sovereigns chased after them.

The shirt-wearing elder was the Third Elder of the Gan Cloud Pavilion. The two Sovereigns next to him had reached the late-stage of the Small Origin Core Realm, and they were all extremely quick.

Over the last month, the elder had mobilized the forces of the Gan Cloud Pavilion and ordered some people to wait in this area.

“Brat, the Gan Cloud Pavilion has surrounded everything within dozens of miles. You won’t be able to escape even if you have wings.”

The shirt-wearing Sovereign Lord roared as he chased after the ship as quick as lightning.

Within the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship, the blood of all the sailors boiled as they felt the pressure from the Great Origin Core Realm. It seemed as if he had merged with nature and become one with the world.

“What speed!”

The Sovereign Lord could only close in slowly while the other two Sovereigns couldn’t catch up.

“This brat actually merged heart blood essence into the ship? What a complete waste!”

The Sovereign Lord’s expression became angry and his eyes became colder.

Whoosh! Whoosh!

Two middle-stage Small Origin Core Realm Sovereigns charged out from in front after the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship had flown a certain distance.

“Brat, stay here!”

The two middle-stage Small Origin Core Realms both attacked and caused waves to roar.

Bam! Bam! Boom~~~~

The cold metallic shell of the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship was still smooth and cold. No damage had been done to it.

“This ship’s defense is extremely strong.”

The two Sovereigns clicked their tongues and used all their strength to try to stop it. Although their attacks couldn’t truly threaten the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship, it wasn’t hard to reduce its speed.

“Hahahaha…. You two, stop that ship.”

The shirt-wearing Sovereign Lord laughed wildly.

The main reason he went after Zhao Feng was because of the heart blood essence. He didn’t think that Zhao Feng still had such a high-grade Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship on top of that.

Even the Gan Cloud Pavilion, a peak one-star clan, didn’t have many ships of such quality.

“Master.”

The skeletal Division Leader appeared from within a layer of dark mist. During the last month, the skeletal Division Leader’s strength had increased by leaps and bounds after using the heart blood essence and the Mystic Dark Crystal Bone.

Ding! Ding! Ding!

The skeletal Division Leader took the brunt of the two Small Origin Core Realms’ attacks and wasn’t injured at all.

“Zhe zhe zhe….”

The skeletal Division Leader laughed as it thrusted out its hand and sent waves of bone spikes toward the two Sovereigns.

Boom!

The two Sovereigns were forced to retreat, and one of them was slightly injured.

Zhao Feng couldn’t help but nod his head. The skeletal Division Leader’s cultivation was closing in on the late-stage of the Small Origin Core Realm, and its bones had been strengthened to a new level – able to ignore attacks from normal Small Origin Core Realms.

Adding on the fact that it had merged the Nine Deadly Yin Bone into its body, the skeletal Division Leader’s battle-power had surpassed the late-stage Small Origin Core Realm and was almost comparable to the Great Origin Core Realm.

“Finish this battle quickly.”

Zhao Feng saw that the three behind them were catching up.

Shua!

He waved a black flag and a hundred cursed ghost-corpses appeared in the air.

Hu~~~~~

A dark mist instantly spread across four or five miles and released a shocking curse.

“Not good!”

The two Sovereigns felt uncomfortable when the mist touched them, and countless dry, white hands that they couldn’t even see clawed into their bodies and ripped their flesh.

The souls and energy of the two Sovereigns were continually depleted, and the injured Sovereign felt worse. It was as if there were ghosts attached to him.

“Mental energy Ghost technique – Ten Thousand Ghost Maze God!”

The red flames in the skeletal Division Leader’s eyes twitched and released illusions of fear and panic into the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.

Shua! Shua!

Zhao Feng waved the black flag, and the mist formed circle after circle that trapped the two Sovereign Lords.

“Wu!”

“Arghhhh~~~!”

The two Sovereigns felt dizzy and released screams as fear overtook their expressions.

One could see their skin and blood starting to rot.
